text: Luke Littler lost 10-8 to Jermaine Wattimena in round two of the Grand Slam of Darts, and Wattimena meets Kevin Doets in Friday's quarter-finals.
Wakamotoharu leads the Kyushu basho at 10-1 after day 11, with Hoshoryu improving to 6-5 by beating Kirishima.
The Mets met free agent ace Tarik Skubal in California on Monday, reportedly the first of six teams to pitch him, and it went very well.
England beat Australia by 97 runs in Hobart to win the ODI series 2-1, with Ben Duckett's 133 and four wickets each for Sonny Baker and Jack Edwards.
The Grand Slam of Curling National runs in Sydney, Nova Scotia until Sunday, with every draw streamed on ESPN+ in the US.
